description: Defines the PHP class 'TemplateDragDropChooser' which generates HTML and JavaScript for a drag-and-drop template interface in SuiteCRM, including methods for rendering the UI, JavaScript class definitions, and required script tags.

classes.name: TemplateDragDropChooser
classes.description: PHP class for rendering drag-and-drop template UI with associated JavaScript for SuiteCRM.

methods.description: Returns HTML tags to include necessary CSS and JavaScript files.
